name: Codex-Skills
title_zh: 给 Codex 装一整套前端交付级技能库
tagline_zh: 从动效到无障碍、从 QA 到交接，六类精品技能一次装齐。专治 Codex 写出的页面“能跑但没法交付”的尴尬。
tagline_en: Six curated skill packs—motion, a11y, QA, handoff—so Codex ships frontend that's actually deliverable, not just.
desc_en: Codex-first Agent Skills library for premium frontend, website, motion, accessibility, QA, and handoff workflows.
why_zh: 按交付链路而非单点功能组织，每个技能都带验收标准。Codex 用它产出的代码，能直接过设计师和 QA 。
why_en: Organized by delivery pipeline, not isolated tricks. Each skill ships with acceptance criteria, so Codex's output survives.
limit_zh: 只认 Codex 系 agent（OpenAI 官方或兼容 CLI），其他框架不保证。技能覆盖前端与交接，不碰后端。
limit_en: Codex-family agents only (official or compatible CLI). Frontend & handoff scope—no backend, DB, or DevOps. Output ends at PR; no deploy or monitoring.
